title: chrysanthemum khorasanicum
intro: Chrysanthemum khorasanicum, commonly known as the Persian chrysanthemum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing the risk of certain diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of C. khorasanicum include its ability to relax and sedate, as well as its potential to reduce anxiety and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
